notes.title: 6th Anniversary Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34910439/13455aa236900e0fe8c156c754b8969e53518092.gif

Hello again, it is the anniversary for the game. It has now been six years since I've released Jump Off The Bridge. When I started this years ago, I didn't expect I'd still be working on this game even now. Perhaps I am much more stubborn than I ever gave myself credit to be - to some a curse, others a boon I suppose. I'm almost 30 years old now, which feels weird to say, since I don't feel 30. I'm enjoying myself when I can, as I hope you are. This update is silly, because I decided to let a joke fall out of my head and put it in a level (Jester at the helm). I've been reshaping my ideology; with the last update, and this as well, I'm making more room for the things that I value and reconnecting with what made me want to make this in the first place. Standards are being defenestrated, along with perfectionism. Imperfection-maxxxing is the new skill I'm working towards. At the end of the day a step is still a step, backwards or forwards. I'd rather move than be immobilized by the sultry 'what if.' Where is this game going? Well I have a lot I still want to do, and I intend to continue working on it. There's a lot of rough edges, but I'm finding the courage to show them. Let's see what I can get done this year. This update adds a level, and fixes a bunch of bugs. I worked on the rebinding menus and controller settings stuff, so that should be more accurate and function better. I haven't made any progress on the Level Editor or Hardmode stuff just yet, maybe next time. Thank you for your support, and thank you for being interested in my weird game. We'll talk soon.

Sincerely,
Your friend,
Cody

notes.title: V1.2.6.0 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34910439/8fe02a04ac5a450660ca69e2ec5c923b416ca363.png

After two and a half years of struggling to release something, I gave myself a new goal: "Whatever I get done by Christmas, I'll release it." Rather than the lofty expectations, or the insidious perfectionism, I aimed to simply just have fun, and to let my heart roam. I had to overcome some things first, some of which you'll face in the update. I expect this update will have many bugs, many loose ends and threads, some in different shades of finish or polish. Regardless it is important for me break the curse of this long sojourn I've had, and simply reconnect with the game and art that was fun for me. A gift for me, a gift for you. Here's to the walk, cheers. We'll talk soon. 

Thank you for being you.
Sincerely,
Cody Penn

notes.title: 5th Anniversary of Jump Off The Bridge! Previews for V2.6!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34910439/f559a10f0fc4aaeef3eea44354db3763c15d7091.gif

It's been five years since I released the game onto Steam. A lot has changed. The game has changed, and I myself have changed. It has been some time since I've released an update, but I've been chiseling away at it. Some days I want to give up, and quit, but I think that's natural. Sometimes I'm anxious about the time I've taken, but every time I sit down to do something, I learn a little more, and take a couple more steps. I'm happy I made it here, wherever this place is. I don't know how long it will take until I release my update, but I care less about that now. As long as I enjoy what I make, that's really all that matters. Thanks for a fun five years! I hope your life is going well. I'm having fun, more than I've had in the past. It's been stressful, but I wouldn't trade it for anything. I'll see you when I see you, keep walking. 

-Sincerely
Cody Penn

notes.title: VERSION 2.3 POLAR BEAR LEVEL
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It has been a couple of months! I ran into a bunch of bugs with the latest Betas of GMS2, so I decided to hold off until those had been patched before I exported a new executable. Since everything seems to be stable, I'm releasing an update with a new level: The Polar Bear Level (and an Achievement). 

This update also includes quite a bit of work on the Gamepad and Keyboard binding controls. The menus should work better overall, allow more intricate binding, and I've fixed the D-Pad movement. Now by default both the Joystick and the D-Pad work for movement, so you can use them interchangeably whilst playing. As well as there was an annoying bug that prevented rebinding on the Keyboard, so that's fixed now!

Also I've enabled Screenshots! Press F12 to Screenshot a part of the game!

Next up will be the Pottery Level voted by my Patreons, featured in the Previews, just have to finish up some work on it before I ship it. I'm aiming for sometime later this week!

I'm changing my philosophy. I've spent too long working on this update, and entered a self-defeating cycle of "took more-time need more-content." My scope for V2.1 was far too grand, and so I'm cutting my losses, and am changing my philosophy. Every time I finish a level, I'm going to update the game. Sorry for the incredibly long wait, hopefully you enjoy what I have in store! All the levels that are a work-in-progress have been denoted accordingly.

Life News
With the help of my family, my patrons, and your support, I'm now renting an office space. We've spent the last few months setting everything up, painting, renovating, etc. I now have a place wholly dedicated to working on this project, which has done wonders for my productivity (and internet speed)!

Day 1 Patches Hotfix 

 IMPROVED THE AUDIO A TON.
 Added more sounds as well.
 It was ruining my immersion for the Reverse Time in Fight 2/3 to not revive the player, so I fixed that.
 Fixed weird bug that allowed double damage on Time Wizard 1/3.
 Fixed Controller quick menu scrolling.
 Fixed delay on throw sound for the Time Wizard.
 Found Infinite Vibrate Controller bug on Pause after death, fixed.
 

2/6/20 Patches Hotfix 2 

 "WANT" Poster -> "WANTED" Poster ;)
 Fixed glitch where bartenders couldn't continue tackling you if you jumped close to them.
 Reverted Hourglasses, to allow them to be broken on the edge of the Time Wizard Fight 2/3.
 Added a blue telegraph that matches the wind wall in phase 2 of Time Wizard 2/3 that indicates more that he only takes damage during those frames with the outline.
 Made DDR actually relevant, repercussions for missing notes is now 50% higher, and you cannot ignore the DDR minigame entirely.
 Improved scythe saving position in Time Wizard fight 2/3. Before it would entirely create a new scythe in the saved position, now if the scythe exists, it will actually teleport back to its original position. As well as the code now prioritizes Holdable Scythes compared to the Enemy Scythes, which means players can plan to save the position of the Scythe in the Lightning Phase of the Time Wizard attack, and retrieve it in another phase, opening up more options for fighting him overall.
 Added Google Translated Subtitles for all languages for just the ending cutscene of the Time Wizard.
 Fixed bug where if you beat Time Wizard 2/3 Old, you'd be stuck old in the falling scene, which makes it almost impossible to beat.
 Added my newest Patron's name to the end screen.


2/9/20 Patches Hotfix 3 

 I ended up breaking the Easymode Time Wizard, after releasing the Hardmode Time Wizard, so I fixed the Easymode Time Wizard. 
 Stuck in Ground on Grandma Level after Easymode Level Select is fixed.
 Fixed TW Part 2/3 Getting stuck in the ground sometimes.
 Slightly changed the colors of the Hourglasses on fight 2/3 to make them more distinct.
 Added a "TIME REVERSE" noise when the clock strikes 12 on 2/3 to help facilitate understanding the mechanic a bit more.

notes.title: V1.7 OLD RUST BOSS & NEW CHECKPOINTS FOR ALL LEVELS
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Intro
First off I'd like to thank my playtesters. They helped me find a ton of bugs, and as a result I patched a bunch of broken stuff this update. Second off I'd like to thank my Patreon Supporters, I'm a bit behind on content for the poll currently, and I appreciate their support, and most of all, their patience. I also have been watching a bunch of playthrough videos on BilliBilli of the game, and have been reading the comments on those videos which has helped motivate me a ton as well as better understand what levels are the most entertaining, so thank you! And if you are reading this, thank you, for being interested in my strange little game.

Update V1.7

 New Easymode Boss Fight: Old Rust
 Slovak Language Support
 Checkpoints for every Easymode Level (If you already had some unlocked, they will be automatically converted into the new system)
 Checkpoints for every Journey to the West Level.
 Checkpoints for all three Halloween Levels.
 Added some turnips to the Cop and Infantry levels in the beginning of the game as well as I added the ability to pickup and throw them.

I've spent a lot of time working on these two commission levels. An awesome person reached out to me about two months ago, and commissioned me to produce levels mocking the Slovak Streamer Fifqo. Originally it was only going to be a single level, but halfway through working on Old Rust, Fifqo got into a scooter accident, and broke a bunch of his ribs. So naturally, I had to mock that. So now we have the Scooter level, as well as the originally commissioned Old Rust Boss fight!

I also decided to make my game a bit less frustrating and added checkpoints for all the levels in the game.

I've also spent a bunch of time working on Patreon content as well, so look forward to that content shortly, I will be uploading it as soon as I finish it.

>Tested with an XBOX 360 Controller and a SNES Buffalo Classic Gamepad
>Controls are rebindable.
>If you have a PS4 Controller, you may have to configure Steam to recognize it as an XBOX 360 controller.

Main Controls REVAMPED
>Default Controls are now [D] and [S] for pickup and throw. 
>Please rebind them to something more comfortable for you!

Collision Revamped
>No more getting stuck in walls! (Hopefully)

Revamped Player Movement
>The player now can change direction without moving a pixel.
>The player can now move 1 pixel by tapping the movement quickly.
>Overall this makes the movement smoother, more precise, and allows players to get close up to the edge of blocks for jumps, making the game slightly easier.

notes.title: TEASER for V1.4
notes.content:
Introduction
Hello everyone! Long time no see! I've spent the last few months working on version 1.4. I figured it was time to post some of the progress, and answer some common questions I've gotten about what the update will contain.

Warning this post will contain spoilers! And warning this is a work in progress!

What will Version 1.4 Contain?
Version 1.4 will contain more content for Easymode, and the first 16 levels of Hardmode (up to the Dragon boss).

What kind of Easymode Content?
I've been fleshing out the existing content, fixing bugs, and adding more levels after the Boomerangs. Specifically I've been working on a small series of content focused on chapters and characters from "Journey to the West" (西遊記):

Journey to the West Entrance:
https://i.imgur.com/kCOuxw4.gif

Journey to the West Temple:
https://i.imgur.com/7cHkgDv.gif

What does Hardmode Content Entail?
Hardmode is a mix of new and old content. The best way to explain them is "remixes" of levels for Easymode. I do not intend to recreate every single level from Easymode, but I'd like to recreate the main ones, and focus more effort into Hardmode levels.

Hardmode Grandma/Dog Level:
https://i.imgur.com/e3vVhiY.gif

Hardmode Cop Level:
https://i.imgur.com/y2jM1jb.gif

Hardmode Dragon Boss:
https://i.imgur.com/YYBMzLY.gif

When will Version 1.4 release? 
I am aiming to complete this version within the coming months. I am currently debating on sidetracking to make some Halloween Themed levels for the holiday, so let me know if that is something you'd enjoy.

When will the MAC Version release?
With V1.4 I am going to procure a MAC computer to compile the game for MAC users, so if all goes well they should release at the same time.

For Time Wizard Fans (Forsen's Community): Will there be more Time Wizard in V1.4?
The easy answer is yes, but how much? I am not sure just yet ;)

Any New Language Support?
I have made some friends that have offered to translate the game in a multitude of languages. But I am always looking for more translators. Specifically I am looking for someone to do future Chinese, Japanese, French, and Spanish translations.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34910439/3889ebad6aaa3e65d2a76f022ba75dbb17e8ca9e.png

Will the price of Jump Off The Bridge increase for the update?
It will increase, but I have not yet decided by how much. 

Outro
Feel free to message me directly on Steam, or my email jumpoffthebridgex@gmail.com regarding any other questions, comments, complaints, level ideas, suggestions, criticisms, or if you are interested in translating the game in your native language.

Thank you everyone for your patience, and comments. I'll see everyone again soon!

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update! Partial 官话 Support! Checkpoint System! 存档! 谢谢!
notes.content:
V1.2 Patch Notes

 Mandarin Support for game text. (All menus will be converted later.)
 Archive/Save/Checkpoint System in place on key levels!
 Infinite Bridge Solution Transition improved.


Hey everyone,

I've been getting a lot of messages about archiving/saving progress. With this patch, I have introduced a system that saves your progress. The first checkpoint is located at the "Puzzle Dog Level." When you've unlocked a checkpoint, it is denoted by the large green lock that appears on your screen. I may add text for that later. When you startup Easymode, you will be taken to a screen that allows you to select the checkpoint you'd like to start at.

I've also been asked about Mandarin support. I've added a menu on load that allows for you to select between English and Mandarin. All the NPC's in game text has been translated via Google Translate, I will be hiring a proper Translator at the end of the month to get better translations. I also will overhaul the menus in a future update to allow the entire game in Mandarin.

Next update will be a content update with more levels in several weeks. Until then, thank you for playing Jump Off The Bridge!  

-Cody Penn
